name: acp-pet-vscode
description: A pet in your sidebar that acts out your editing and your coding agent's work, and takes turns between characters.

commands.title: 餵任務給寵物 (Give the pet a task)
取消目前任務 (Cancel the task)

acpPet.characters.description: Skin ids that take turns. Bundled: hikari, nozomi, deepseek, flandre, remilia, their -pixel versions, and the chicks (chick, snow, mint, sakura, night). Folders in ~/.acp-pet/skins work too.

acpPet.rotateMinutes.description: Switch to the next character every N minutes. 0 keeps the current one.

acpPet.agent.description: acpx agent that runs tasks you give the pet (claude, codex, gemini…). It must already be installed and logged in.

acpPet.reactToEditor.description: Act out your own editing too: typing, saving, errors, tasks and debugging.

acpPet.permissionTimeoutSec.description: Seconds before an unanswered permission sign counts as Deny.
